entities.summary: Istralandia in Brtonigla, Croatia, is a water park with a broad mix of slides and pools.
entities.description: Istralandia is a water park in Brtonigla, Croatia, offering enough slide and pool variety for a dedicated outing. It particularly suits children aged about six and older, teenagers and adults who enjoy trying different water rides. Check the seasonal operating calendar and individual slide restrictions before travel.
entities.whyWorthwhile: Istralandia in Brtonigla offers a broad choice of slides and pools, making it worth choosing for a varied water-park outing.
